user.title: Göttingen waste calendar (GEB)
user.description: Enter street and house number as used on the GEB website (e.g. "Lindenweg" and "15"). The calendar link is looked up automatically.

error.cannot_connect: Could not load the calendar. Check the street/house number and your internet connection.
error.timeout: Timed out while fetching the calendar.
error.no_events: No events were found for that street/house number. Check the spelling (e.g. "Str." instead of "Straße").
